rooms.name: Deluxe Room
rooms.description: A comfortable and stylish room with thoughtful amenities for a relaxing and rejuvenating stay.
rooms.overview: The Deluxe Room offers a calm and comfortable space to unwind after a day of exploring Varanasi. Warm, earthy tones and thoughtful details bring together everyday comforts and a sense of place for a relaxed stay.
rooms.caption: A cosy and elegant space for a relaxing getaway.

rooms.name: Premium Room
rooms.description: A larger room with extra space, ideal for families, couples or travellers who enjoy a little more.
rooms.overview: The Premium Room brings a more spacious feel to your stay, with room to sit, read and unwind. Suitable for couples or a small family, it offers a comfortable setting for unhurried mornings and quiet evenings after exploring the city.
rooms.caption: Spacious comfort with a touch of luxury.

rooms.name: Family Room
rooms.description: A versatile room perfect for families, with comfortable space for everyone to relax, reconnect and feel at home.
rooms.overview: The Family Room is designed around time together, with sleeping arrangements for up to four guests and a place to relax between outings. Let us know the ages of your children and your preferred bed setup so our team can help plan a comfortable stay.
rooms.caption: Room for everyone, and memories that last.

rooms.name: Dormitory Room
rooms.description: A comfortable and affordable option, ideal for groups or budget travellers. Share the vibe, make new friends, and experience more together.
rooms.overview: Our shared dormitory offers individual bunk beds for solo travellers, friends and groups. Enquire by the number of beds you need, and tell us about your group so the team can confirm availability, room arrangements and the facilities for your stay.
rooms.caption: Concept image · Shared dormitory room with multiple bunk beds.

faqs.question: Is a dormitory room available at The Mud House?
faqs.answer: Our room selection includes a shared dormitory with multiple bunk beds, air conditioning and bathroom access. It’s an option for groups or budget travellers. Please enquire for bed availability and group stays.

faqs.question: Are all rooms air-conditioned?
faqs.answer: Air conditioning is listed for each room category. Our team can confirm the facilities in your allocated room before you book.

faqs.question: Is breakfast included in the room rate?
faqs.answer: Breakfast inclusion is not yet confirmed and may depend on your room and rate plan. Please check what is included when requesting your quote.

faqs.question: Can I book multiple rooms for a group?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can enquire about several rooms together. Share your dates, guest count and preferred room types, and our team will help you explore the available options.

faqs.question: Do you offer long-stay discounts?
faqs.answer: Ask our team for a quote based on your dates and length of stay. Any extended-stay rates are subject to availability and confirmation.

faqs.question: Can children stay, and can an extra bed be arranged?
faqs.answer: Share the number and ages of children, your room preference and any extra bedding needs when you enquire. Extra beds depend on room type and availability. Sleeping arrangements and any additional charges need to be confirmed with your quote.

faqs.question: Can I bring a pet?
faqs.answer: Please contact the team to confirm the current pet policy before booking. The policy and any arrangements are awaiting confirmation.

faqs.question: Can I dine without staying at the hotel?
faqs.answer: Our non-resident dining policy is awaiting confirmation. Please contact the team before planning a visit.

faqs.question: What cuisine is served?
faqs.answer: Our cuisine and menu approach are still to be confirmed. Browse the food concepts on the Food Menu page, then ask the team for the current menu and available dishes.

faqs.question: What are the restaurant’s service hours?
faqs.answer: Service hours, operating days and last orders are awaiting confirmation. Include your preferred date and time in a table request and the team will advise.

faqs.question: How do table requests work?
faqs.answer: Share your preferred date, time and guest count, review your details, and send your request to our team. A reference number confirms that it was received. Your table is reserved only when the team confirms availability with you.

faqs.question: How can I discuss dietary or access requirements?
faqs.answer: Add your dietary, access or seating needs to the request form. Please confirm ingredients, allergens and access arrangements directly with the team before your visit; accommodations are subject to confirmation.

faqs.question: Is accommodation included in every package?
faqs.answer: Not necessarily. Some experiences include a stay, while others are day experiences only. Details are subject to confirmation for each package.

faqs.question: What does the displayed price cover?
faqs.answer: Prices are currently awaiting confirmation. Request a quote for your dates and group, and ask the team to confirm the full price, inclusions, exclusions, taxes and any additional charges.

faqs.question: Are experiences private or shared?
faqs.answer: The arrangement for each experience is awaiting confirmation. Share your group size and preference for a private or shared experience in your enquiry.

faqs.question: How do I discuss access or group requirements?
faqs.answer: Add any walking, access, timing or group requirements to the travel enquiry form. Please confirm the route, transport and suitability with the team before booking.

faqs.question: What are the check-in and check-out times?
faqs.answer: Arrival and departure times are unconfirmed. Please ask the team before travelling. Include any early arrival or late departure request in your enquiry so the available arrangements can be discussed.

faqs.question: How do I reach the hotel, and can you help with transfers?
faqs.answer: Contact the team for the confirmed address, airport and railway station guidance, and local transport options. Transfer availability, pickup arrangements and charges need to be confirmed before you travel.

faqs.question: How can I check whether the hotel meets my access needs?
faqs.answer: Tell the team about any access or assistance requirements before booking. Ask them to confirm the floor level, lift or steps, door widths, bathroom arrangement and route to the room offered. Verified room dimensions and floor plans are not currently available on the website.

faqs.question: How do I check room availability and rates?
faqs.answer: Choose your dates, guest count and room preference, then prepare an enquiry for the team. The website does not show live availability or confirmed rates. The team will need to confirm availability, the proposed room and a quote for your dates.

faqs.question: When is my booking confirmed?
faqs.answer: An enquiry is not a confirmed booking. The team will confirm availability, your proposed arrangements, the quote and any booking conditions with you before a booking can be confirmed.

faqs.question: Does submitting a website form send my enquiry automatically?
faqs.answer: Review your details, accept the privacy notice, and select Send request to send your enquiry to our team. A reference number confirms that it was received. Our team will contact you about availability and arrangements; the request itself is not a confirmed booking. If sending fails, you can try again or use the email option.

faqs.question: How do payments and deposits work?
faqs.answer: Payment methods, deposit requirements, taxes and any additional charges are to be confirmed with your quote. Terms may vary by room, rate plan or experience. The website does not collect payments.

faqs.question: What are the cancellation, change and refund terms?
faqs.answer: Cancellation, booking changes and refund conditions are awaiting confirmation and may vary by rate plan or arrangement. Ask the team for the terms that apply to your quote before confirming a booking; no cancellation deadline, fee or refund entitlement is confirmed on this website.
